title: ABRIDGED BID NOTICE UNDER OPEN DOMESTIC BIDDING - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# ABRIDGED BID NOTICE UNDER OPEN DOMESTIC BIDDING
Uganda Revenue Authority invites sealed bids from eligible bidders for:
Procurement Reference Number
Subject matter of Procurement
Prebid Meeting
Date of Bid Closing
Bid Security
URA/ITID/NCON/26-27/00931
Provision of Support and Maintenance of Cyber Security Awareness Platform -Knowb4.
Friday 02 nd October, 2026 at 10:00am
Wednesday 21 st October, 2026 at 10:00am
5,000,000
URA/ITID/NCON/26-27/00937
Acquisition of an IT Service Management Tool
Friday 02 nd October, 2026 at 10:00am
Wednesday 21 st October, 2026 at 10:00am
10,000,000
The bidding document(s) shall be inspected and issued at the address below;
The Assistant Commissioner, Procurement and Disposal Division,
Uganda Revenue Authority Headquarters,
Plot M193/M194, Nakawa Industrial Area,
13 th Floor, URA Tower – Procurement Office
P.O. Box 7279, Kampala.
Contact: +256 417442087
Email: ProcurementInquiries@ura.go.ug
The Bidding document in English may be collected by interested bidders upon payment of nonrefundable fee and submission of a written application letter to the Assistant Commissioner Procurement and Disposal Division at the address in (2) above.
Bidders are advised to generate Bank Payment Registration Slips from the URA website at ura.go.ug and make payment of a non-refundable fee of UGX: 100,000 to any bank authorized to receive Non-Tax Revenue fees on behalf of URA.
The deadline for bid submission shall be at Wednesday 21 st October, 2026 at 10:00am
The detailed bid notice is available at the Entity’s website at https://ura.go.ug and at ppda.go.ug.
Uganda Revenue Authority is regulated by the Public Procurement and Disposal of Public Assets
ACCOUNTING OFFICER
